title: Shirya yaƙin neman zaɓe, gwada ƙananan tallace-tallace kuma ku sani idan kun sami kuɗi
course_title: Tushen Tallan Dijital don Kananan Kasuwanci

say: Shirya kamfen, gwada ƙananan tallace-tallace, kuma ku sani idan kun sami kuɗi.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na huɗu: yaƙin neman zaɓe, tallace-tallacen da aka biya, aunawa da haɓaka.
Yaƙin neman zaɓe shine mayar da hankali tare da manufa ɗaya, tayin, ranar farawa da ƙarshen ƙarshe, da kasafin kuɗi. Rubuta taƙaitaccen shafi guda ɗaya kafin ku kashe naira.
Maryam a Kaduna tana sayar da kayan makaranta. Manufarta ita ce umarni 60 tsakanin 1 zuwa 31 ga Agusta.

say: Maryam ta yi tunanin yadda nasara ta kasance kafin ta fara. Waɗannan alkalumman misalai ne.
Tana samun ribar kusan naira 3,500 a kowane oda. Wato karya-koda kudinta na kowane oda. Tana so ta ajiye akalla rabi, don haka burinta shine 1,750 ko ƙasa da haka.
Ta sanya kusan 40,000 a cikin talla sama da makonni 3, da 10,000 a cikin foda tare da lambar QR ta WhatsApp.
Wato kimanin naira 50,000 kenan. Ta tambayi kowane mai siye, a ina kuka ga tayinmu, kuma ta sanya wa kowane taɗi ta hanyar tushe.
Zaɓi makasudin da ya dace da aikin da kuke so. Ga masu siyar da WhatsApp, tallan danna-zuwa-WhatsApp yana buɗe tattaunawa da ku.
Amaka ya gwada kimanin Naira 14,000 a cikin kwanaki 7, a Fatakwal, da tallace-tallace biyu. Hoton platter ya sami umarni 4.

panel.heading: Talla biyu na Amaka: hoto ko bidiyo?

say: Bidiyon shiryawa ya sami umarni 9, kusan rabin farashin kowane oda. Don haka ta kashe Ad A.
Kwatanta tallace-tallace ta farashi akan kowane oda, ba kawai farashin kowane danna ba. Gwada da kuɗin da za ku iya rasa.

say: Ngozi ta kashe naira 30,000 wajen tallata shafinta na gyaran fata, kuma ta samu sayayya 18. Wato kusan naira 1,667 akan kowane saye.

panel.heading: Kamfen ya samu kudi?

cards.d: Ku kashe ta hanyar sayayya. Naira 30,000 na sayayya 18 kusan 1,667 kowanne.
Kudaden shiga daga tallace-tallace da aka raba ta hanyar kashe talla. 216,000 da aka raba ta 30,000 shine 7.2.
Ribar kowane oda kafin tallace-tallace ya kasance 5,000. Farashin kowane sayan yana ƙasa da shi sosai.

say: Wadanda aka siya sun kawo naira 216,000. Komawa kan ciyarwar talla ana raba kudaden shiga ta hanyar kashewa: 7.2.

Dokar: idan farashin kowane oda yana ƙasa da riba kowane oda kafin talla, yaƙin neman zaɓe ya sami kuɗi.

Kuma umarni sau biyu yana da kyau kawai idan har yanzu kuna iya bayarwa akan lokaci.

say: Don tunawa. Rubuta taƙaitaccen bayani tare da tayin gaskiya. Gwada ƙananan, kuma kwatanta tallace-tallace ta farashi akan kowane tsari.
Duba riba, ba kawai kudaden shiga ba. Canja abu ɗaya a lokaci guda, kuma kuyi girma a hankali.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Rubuta taƙaitaccen shafi ɗaya tare da tayin gaskiya
Gwada ƙananan, tare da kuɗin da za ku iya rasa
Kwatanta ta farashi akan kowane oda, ba farashin kowane danna ba
Riba, ba kudaden shiga ba, yana gaya muku idan tallace-tallace sun yi aiki
Canja abu daya a lokaci guda; sikelin a hankali

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Rubuta taƙaitaccen bayanin ku tare da farashi-ko da kowane tsari, tsara tallace-tallace biyu, ƙididdige ma'aunin ku, kuma gudanar da gwajin A/B mai adalci.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Rubuta takaitaccen yakin neman zabe
Shirya ko gudanar da ƙaramin gwajin talla
Yi lissafin ma'aunin kamfen ɗin ku
Guda gwajin A/B guda ɗaya kuma aiwatar da CLV ɗin ku
